title: Biff is a command line datetime Swiss army knife
summary: Biff is a command-line datetime Swiss army knife created by BurntSushi (known for ripgrep), designed to handle various datetime parsing, formatting, and conversion operations directly in the terminal. It provides a unified interface for common datetime tasks that are otherwise tedious to perform via shell commands.
problem_solved: Solves the pain of datetime manipulation at the command line, where developers otherwise need to write custom scripts or combine multiple utilities to parse, convert, or format dates.
why_valuable: It provides a fast, focused, all-in-one datetime tool that eliminates the need for writing one-off code for common date operations in shell scripts and command-line workflows.
